title: Constrained Policy Optimization for Provably Fair Order Matching
summary: Automated matching engines execute millions of orders per session, yet systematic asymmetries in latency, order size, and market access compound into persistent execution disparities that erode participant trust. We formulate provably fair order matching as a Constrained Markov Decision Process and propose CPO-FOAM (Constrained Policy Optimization with Feedback-Optimized Adaptive Margins).
